root: ^Elara sets a clean cup beside the hearth. "Catch your breath. The road can wait."

c-0: ^"One visit restores all your Health, Mana and Stamina. If Alby defeats you, I will bring you home and tend you for free. Your gold and claimed rewards stay yours."
c-1: ^"There. Steady hands and a clear head. Take care out there."
c-2: ^"Cross the stream for Nell's bread and Bram's forge. Petra keeps the bank just south of here. Aren watches the northern approach."
